reviews.text: Stopped in today for help. Sandy tested my water, and told me exactly what to do to clear up my pool water. Called 2 times for help as well. She was helpful, and didn't get mad at all. There prices are NOT overpriced. I rather support our local businesses then some big chain.
reviews.author: David Hagar

reviews.text: I want to show my appreciation to Supreme Pools of Cleburne! These guys are so helpful,  it’s nice to do business with a company that really goes the extra mile to help.  I always enjoy going in and chatting with whoever is behind the desk at them time, they shoot straight  with ya no sales pressure and the maintenance guy Kyle that we have used a few times is top notch every time he comes out to service our pool.  Thank you Staff!
reviews.author: Teri Webb

reviews.text: The owner is always attentive and very knowledgeable, always willing to help! great prices,
reviews.author: Ismael Reyes

reviews.text: I absolutely recommend this place for all your pool needs above or under ground they know their stuff. I take my water in and have it sampled free of charge monthly and the woman behind the desk is very knowledgeable. She is always helping me when I have questions and has never steered me wrong. If it wasnt for her I would have given up on my above ground pool but she brought it back to life. Thanks for all you do.
reviews.author: Glenda Garrett

reviews.text:
Supreme Pool remodeled our pool and did an awesome job!   There were some delays in starting but that was not their fault...we have had a lot of rain this year.   Once they started they were on it until done.  The pool looks so good.  They are always there to answer your questions and if you can't figure something out they are at your house showing you how things work.  I am very impressed and would recommend them to anyone having a pool built or remodelled in Johnson County.  Very professional!!

Thanks Sandy & Larry!!!
Dana
reviews.author: Dana Strauch

reviews.text: They recommended the filtration system I needed for my pool, and installed it in a timely manner. They also worked with my home warranty company to get as much of my repairs covered as possible. Thank you supreme pools.
reviews.author: Johnny Gonzalez

reviews.text: I absolutely recommend Supreme Pools for your pool needs.  They helped me understand how to test my water and add chemicals.  When I have and issue such as opening for the summer, they dont have me adding unnecessary chemical like the "other" stores and they dont push product on you.
reviews.author: Vickie Inboden

reviews.text: She is the BEST!!!! She has helped me out so much and is so knowledgeable on things I didn't even know. Highly recommend this place!
reviews.author: Devon Learmont
